summary: Extracts values from a data cube for specific locations
description:
This process will extract values from a data cube `data` at specific locations, provided as vector geometries in `geometries`.

If the geometry is a Point, a  value will be extracted at each Point location.
If the geometry is a Line, a value will be extracted for the center of each raster cell the line intersects.
If the geometry is a Polygon, a value will be extracted for the center of each raster cell inside the polygon.

All geometries will be clipped to the extend of the data cube.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: The data cube from which values are to be extracted

parameters.name: geometries
parameters.description: Location at which values are to be extracted from the data cube. Must be a GeoJSON FeatureCollection of Geometries

returns.description:
A vector data cube containing the values sampled at the provided geometry locations.

The resulting data cube will have all dimensions which `data` had (time, band etc.), except for the X and Y dimensions, which will have been replaced with a geometry dimension.

The geometry dimension contains the Points at which the data has been sampled.
